title: Laser Microdissection for Regional Proteomics
author: Samir Parikh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.brrqm55w
materials: Liquid chromatography tandem-mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis is performed with an Easy-nLC 1000 coupled to an Orbitrap Eclipse mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA). Orbitrap Eclipse (Mass Spectrometer, Thermo Scientific, 00-0000)
Data analysis is performed using Proteome Discoverer 2.2 (Thermo Scientific).
Prepare all tubes with 13 mL each of required solutions

steps.title: Prepare Paraffin Sections
steps.instruction: Collect 10 µm thick paraffin sections in a mass spec clean container with mass spec H2O (heat water in the container in the tissue water bath; do not use a microwave).

steps.title: Dry and Deparaffinize Slides
steps.instruction: Air dry slides and perform a series of washes to remove paraffin.

substeps.instruction: Place air-dried slides in a desiccator with desiccant stones under vacuum for 7 days.
Place slides in 3 changes of octane for 00:02:00 each, occasionally inverting the tube.
Place slides in 3 changes of absolute ethanol for 00:02:00 each, with occasional gentle inversion.
Place slides in 1 change of 90% absolute ethanol for 00:02:00 with occasional gentle inversion.
Place slides in 1 change of 70% absolute ethanol for 00:02:00 with occasional gentle inversion.
Place slides in 2 changes of H2O for 00:02:00 each with occasional gentle inversion.

steps.title: Stain and Rehydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Stain the slides and re-process using fresh solutions (not those used for deparaffinization).

substeps.instruction: Remove slides from H2O and stain with a few drops of hematoxylin for 2-5 seconds.
Immediately rinse in 2 changes of H2O for 00:02:00 each with occasional gentle inversion.
Place slides in 1 change of 70% absolute ethanol for 00:02:00 with occasional gentle inversion.
Place slides in 95% ethanol for 00:02:00 with occasional gentle inversion.
Place slides in 2 changes of absolute ethanol for 00:02:00 each with occasional gentle inversion.
Remove slides and air dry for LMD.
If staining with Hematoxylin, place slides in MS grade water for 00:00:30 X 2.

steps.title: Perform Final Slide Washes
steps.instruction: Perform final cleaning and hydration steps before microdissection.

substeps.instruction: Place slides in MS grade water for 00:02:00 X 2, using fresh MS grade water for each wash.
Stain slides with Hematoxylin QS (optional).
Place slides in 70% ethanol for 00:02:00.
Place slides in 95% ethanol for 00:02:00.
Place slides in 100% ethanol #1 for 00:02:00.
Place slides in 100% ethanol #2 for 00:02:00.
Make a stock solution of 1M or 0.5M NH3HCO3; store in refrigerator for max 2 weeks and discard if precipitate is present.
For a single 0.2 mg Rapigest tube (final concentration 0.5%), add 200 µL of 50 mM NH3HCO3 to the vial with Rapigest.
Gently swirl for 00:00:20 - 00:00:30 and keep refrigerated for no more than 2 weeks.

steps.title: Perform Laser Microdissection (LMD)
steps.instruction: Collect cells using the Leica DFC7000T scope.

substeps.instruction: Use 25 µL of 0.5% Rapigest to collect each LMPC sample.
Collect ~20,000 cells for each sample in under 02:00:00.
Immediately freeze the collected sample in a PCR tube using dry ice and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Tubes for Digestion
steps.instruction: Modify tubes to ensure efficient processing.

substeps.instruction: Cut off the sides of the PCR tube cap.
Place 0.2 mL tubes into 1.5 mL tubes with the bottoms cut off; apply pressure and secure with a 10 µL pipette tip.

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins using trypsin and optional heat treatment.

substeps.instruction: Cool and add trypsin (200 ng/µl in 50 mM NH3HCO3) at a ratio of 1/30th the amount of total protein in the sample.
Briefly centrifuge at 13,000 rpm.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C.
If FFPE, incubate sample at 60 °C for 02:00:00.
Add formic acid to a final volume of 30% until cloudiness is visualized.
Incubate at 37 °C for 00:30:00.
Centrifuge for 00:10:00 at 15,000 rpm and collect supernatant without disturbing the pellet; repeat for a total of three centrifugations.
Dry the sample using a Speedvac and confirm the presence of an amber pellet.

steps.title: Peptide Recovery and Quantification
steps.instruction: Resuspend and quantify the recovered peptides.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL total of 2% acetonitrile and 0.1% formic acid mixture.
Vortex briefly and centrifuge briefly to bring solution to the bottom.
Place tube in an ice-cold sonicating water bath for 00:01:00, then briefly centrifuge.
Check peptide concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer at 280 nm absorbance.
Determine if protein efficiency of recovery is > 50%.

steps.title: LC-MS/MS Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze 1.5 µg of peptides using an OrbiTrap Eclipse mass spectrometer and LC system.

substeps.instruction: Load 1.5 µg of peptides onto a 25 cm Magic C18 AQ 100 Å reverse-phase column (75 μm ID) with an IntegraFrit Capillary trap (100 μm ID) containing Magic C18 AQ 200 Å (2 cm).
Separate using a two-mobile-phase system: 0.1% formic acid in water (A) and 0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile (B).
Apply a 163-min gradient at 300 nl/min: 2 to 50% B (5–30% B for 02:30:00, 30–50% B for 00:10:00, and 50% B for 00:03:00).
Operate mass spectrometer in data dependent MS/MS mode (m/z 400–1,500) with resolution 120,000, AGC target 2 × 10^5, and injection time 50 ms.

For MS2: use quadrupole isolation window of 1.6 m/z, cycle time 3 s, charge state 2-6, 27% normalized HCD collision energy, ion trap AGC target 1 × 10^4, injection time 90 ms, and 20s dynamic exclusion.

steps.title: Data Processing and Bioinformatics
steps.instruction: Process raw MS data to identify proteins.

substeps.instruction: Set trypsin as enzyme with max 2 missed cleavages; precursor tolerance 10 ppm, fragment tolerance 0.6 Da.
Set variable modifications: carbamidomethyl on cysteine and oxidation of methionine.
Run SEQUEST results through Percolator; filter by 1% peptide-level FDR (q value 0.01) and ≤1% protein-level FDR.
Perform mass calibration weekly (< 3 ppm accuracy) and full calibration monthly.
Daily/intermittently inject a five-peptide standard (500 fmol each): retention time deviation < 1 min, mass accuracy < 3 ppm, resolution > 120,000 at m/z 200.
Test full data collection mode before long sets by injecting 200 ng trypsin-digested yeast lysate; minimum 6000 proteins should be detected (< 1% FDR).
